label: Hikes
blurb: Great day hikes and multi-day treks, ranked by the outdoor press.

places.name: Tour du Mont Blanc
places.why: Circles the Mont Blanc massif through three countries on hut-linked trails; start at the Les Houches trailhead.

places.name: GR20
places.why: Europe's toughest long trail, a chain of granite ridges and refuges across Corsica; starts at the Calenzana trailhead.

places.name: West Highland Way
places.why: Scotland's original long-distance path from lowland Milngavie to Fort William beneath Ben Nevis; trailhead in Milngavie.

places.name: Camino de Santiago (Camino Frances)
places.why: The classic 780 km pilgrim route to Santiago de Compostela, walked hostel to hostel; trailhead in Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port.

places.name: Haute Route (Chamonix to Zermatt)
places.why: A glaciated high-level traverse linking Chamonix to Zermatt past four of the Alps' highest peaks; trailhead in Chamonix.

places.name: Alta Via 1
places.why: The best-known Dolomites traverse, refuge to refuge past the Tofane and Marmolada; trailhead at Lago di Braies.

places.name: E5 Alpine Crossing
places.why: The classic hut-to-hut crossing of the Alps from Bavaria to South Tyrol, with the exposed Heilbronner Weg en route; trailhead in Oberstdorf.

places.name: Kungsleden
places.why: The 'King's Trail' through Arctic Sweden's fells and reindeer country, hut to hut above the tree line; trailhead in Abisko.

places.name: Karhunkierros Trail
places.why: The 'Bear's Trail' through the Oulanka canyon along the Russian border, with suspension bridges over rapids; trailhead at Kiutakongas.

places.name: Robert Louis Stevenson Trail (GR70)
places.why: Retraces Stevenson's 1878 donkey trek across the volcanic Cevennes; trailhead in Le Puy-en-Velay.

places.name: Pennine Way
places.why: England's oldest national trail, up the Pennine spine through peat moor and limestone dale; trailhead in Edale.

places.name: Coast to Coast Walk
places.why: Wainwright's unofficial classic across three national parks from the Irish Sea to the North Sea; trailhead at St Bees.

places.name: South West Coast Path
places.why: Britain's longest national trail, 1,014 km of clifftop path around the southwest peninsula; northern trailhead at Minehead.

places.name: Skye Trail
places.why: An unmarked traverse of Skye's wildest coast and the Trotternish and Cuillin ridges; trailhead near Broadford.

places.name: Cape Wrath Trail
places.why: Britain's toughest long walk, an unmarked route through the empty Northwest Highlands to Cape Wrath; trailhead in Fort William.

places.name: Rota Vicentina (Fishermen's Trail)
places.why: A sandy clifftop path down Portugal's wild Alentejo and Algarve coast; trailhead in Porto Covo.

places.name: Lycian Way
places.why: An ancient shepherd's path along Turkey's turquoise coast, past Lycian tombs and pine forest; trailhead in Fethiye.

places.name: Selvaggio Blu
places.why: Italy's hardest trek, an exposed scramble along Sardinia's Gulf of Orosei limestone coast; trailhead at Pedra Longa.

places.name: Cinque Terre coastal path
places.why: Terraced vineyards and pastel villages linked by cliffside trail above the Ligurian Sea; key viewpoint at Punta Mesco.

places.name: Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock)
places.why: A sheer 604 m granite plateau over Lysefjord, Norway's most photographed viewpoint.

places.name: Trolltunga
places.why: A rock slab jutting horizontally 700 m above Lake Ringedalsvatnet, reached by a long alpine day hike.

places.name: Besseggen Ridge
places.why: A knife-edge ridge between two lakes of different colour in Jotunheimen National Park; key viewpoint atop the ridge.

places.name: Kjeragbolten
places.why: A boulder wedged in a crevasse a thousand metres above Lysefjord, the ultimate photo op of the Kjerag massif.

places.name: Zugspitze via Hoellental
places.why: Germany's highest summit, reached via the glaciated Hoellental valley and via-ferrata sections.

places.name: Schilthorn hike
places.why: A high balcony trail below the Eiger, Moench and Jungfrau, ending at the Schilthorn's 360-degree summit viewpoint.

places.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop
places.why: A loop beneath the Dolomites' most famous three-peaked spire, viewpoint at Rifugio Locatelli.

places.name: Seceda Ridgeline
places.why: A jagged green ridgeline with the Odle peaks behind, one of the Dolomites' most photographed viewpoints.

places.name: Mount Olympus (Mytikas)
places.why: The mythical home of the gods, a two-day scramble to Mytikas' 2,918 m summit via mountain refuges.

places.name: Samaria Gorge
places.why: Europe's longest gorge walk, descending 16 km from the Omalos plateau to the Libyan Sea; trailhead at Xyloskalo.

places.name: Vikos Gorge
places.why: One of the world's deepest gorges relative to width, viewed from the Oxya viewpoint above the Zagori villages.

places.name: Triglav
places.why: Slovenia's highest peak and national symbol, a two-day via-ferrata-assisted climb from mountain huts.

places.name: Bobotov Kuk, Durmitor
places.why: Montenegro's highest summit above the glacial lakes of Durmitor National Park.

places.name: Rysy
places.why: The highest summit reachable by hiking in the High Tatras, straddling the Polish-Slovak border.

places.name: Musala
places.why: The Balkans' highest peak, a long day hike through the Rila Mountains above Borovets.

places.name: Ruta del Cares
places.why: A cliffside path carved into the Cares Gorge between Cain and Poncebos, the Picos de Europa's signature walk.

places.name: Caminito del Rey
places.why: A restored boardwalk clinging to the Gaitanes Gorge walls a hundred metres above the Guadalhorce river.

places.name: Pedraforca
places.why: A twin-pronged limestone massif and Catalonia's most iconic scramble, summit views over the Pyrenees.

places.name: Mount Teide
places.why: Spain's highest peak, a volcanic summit above a sea of clouds; permit required for the final stretch at dawn.

places.name: Caldera de Taburiente
places.why: An eight-kilometre-wide eroded volcanic crater, viewed from the Mirador de los Roques de los Muchachos.

places.name: Vereda do Pico Ruivo
places.why: Madeira's highest summit, a cloud-forest ridge walk above the island's central peaks.

places.name: Peneda-Geres viewpoint trail
places.why: Granite peaks and waterfalls in Portugal's only national park, viewpoint at Pedra Bela.

places.name: Lake Sorvagsvatn / Traelanipa
places.why: An optical-illusion lake seeming to hang above the ocean, viewpoint at the Traelanipa cliff.

places.name: Kallur Lighthouse, Kalsoy
places.why: A narrow island ridge walk to a lighthouse perched between two sheer drops to the sea.

places.name: Kebnekaise
places.why: Sweden's highest peak, a glacier route from mountain stations above the Arctic Circle.

places.name: Laugavegur Trail
places.why: Iceland's classic multi-day trek through rhyolite mountains, obsidian fields and glacial rivers; trailhead at Landmannalaugar.

places.name: Fimmvorduhals
places.why: A day-long crossing between two glaciers past young lava fields from the 2010 Eyjafjallajokull eruption; trailhead at Skogar.

places.name: Glymur
places.why: A hike to the viewpoint above Iceland's second-highest waterfall, crossing the river on a fallen log.

places.name: Storurd
places.why: Giant boulders scattered beside turquoise tarns below jagged peaks in Iceland's East Fjords.

places.name: Puy de Sancy
places.why: The highest point in the Massif Central, an extinct volcano summit over the Chaine des Puys.

places.name: Pic du Midi d'Ossau
places.why: A dramatic twin-peaked volcanic plug and one of the Pyrenees' great scrambles.

places.name: Lac Blanc, Aiguilles Rouges
places.why: An alpine tarn with a postcard reflection of the Mont Blanc massif across the valley.

places.name: Aletsch Glacier viewpoint
places.why: A balcony trail above the Alps' longest glacier, viewpoint at the Bettmerhorn.

places.name: Five Lakes Walk (Funf-Seenweg)
places.why: Five alpine lakes strung beneath the Matterhorn, each with its own reflected view of the peak.

places.name: Mont Blanc summit route
places.why: Western Europe's highest summit via the classic Gouter route, a glaciated multi-day climb from mountain huts.

places.name: Ben Nevis
places.why: Britain's highest summit, a long climb from Glen Nevis up the Pony Track.

places.name: Snowdon via Pyg Track
places.why: Wales' highest peak, reached via the exposed Pyg Track above Llyn Llydaw.

places.name: Scafell Pike
places.why: England's highest summit, a rocky climb from Wasdale through the heart of the Lake District.

places.name: Helvellyn via Striding Edge
places.why: A narrow, exposed scramble along a knife-edge ridge to one of the Lake District's finest summits.

places.name: Cadair Idris
places.why: A dramatic glaciated summit above a corrie lake in southern Snowdonia.

places.name: Pen y Fan
places.why: The highest peak in southern Britain, a short, popular climb used by military training and walkers alike.

places.name: Kumano Kodo (Nakahechi route)
places.why: A thousand-year-old pilgrimage route through cedar forest to the Kumano Sanzan shrines; trailhead at Takijiri-oji.

places.name: Everest Base Camp Trek
places.why: The world's most famous trek, teahouse to teahouse beneath the highest peak on Earth; trailhead in Lukla.

places.name: Annapurna Circuit
places.why: A classic circumnavigation of the Annapurna massif over the Thorong La pass; trailhead in Besisahar.

places.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
places.why: A teahouse trek into the natural amphitheatre of Annapurna Sanctuary; trailhead in Nayapul.

places.name: Poon Hill
places.why: A short pre-dawn climb to a sweeping sunrise viewpoint over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.

places.name: Manaslu Circuit
places.why: A remote, restricted-area trek around the world's eighth-highest peak over the Larkya La pass; trailhead at Soti Khola.

places.name: Langtang Valley Trek
places.why: A quieter Himalayan valley trek to glacier viewpoints below Langtang Lirung; trailhead in Syabrubesi.

places.name: Mardi Himal Trek
places.why: A less-crowded ridge trek to a dramatic close-up base camp view of Machapuchare; trailhead at Kande.

places.name: Gokyo Ri
places.why: A steep climb above turquoise glacial lakes for one of the best panoramas of Everest and Cho Oyu.

places.name: Roopkund Trek
places.why: A high-altitude trek to a mysterious skeleton lake in the Garhwal Himalaya; trailhead in Lohajung.

places.name: Valley of Flowers Trek
places.why: A UNESCO alpine valley that erupts into wildflower meadows each monsoon; trailhead in Ghangaria.

places.name: Hampta Pass Trek
places.why: A dramatic crossing from green Kullu valley to the arid Lahaul desert over a high pass; trailhead at Jobra.

places.name: Chadar Trek
places.why: A walk on the frozen Zanskar river, one of the world's most extreme winter treks; trailhead at Chilling.

places.name: Markha Valley Trek
places.why: A high desert trek past Ladakhi villages and monasteries beneath Kang Yatse; trailhead at Zingchen.

places.name: Tiger's Nest (Paro Taktsang)
places.why: A monastery clinging to a cliff 900 m above the Paro valley, Bhutan's most sacred pilgrimage climb.

places.name: Snowman Trek
places.why: Widely called the world's hardest trek, three weeks of high passes through Bhutan's remote north; trailhead at Drukgyel Dzong.

places.name: Tiger Leaping Gorge
places.why: A trail along one of the world's deepest gorges, the Jinsha River roaring below jagged peaks; trailhead in Qiaotou.

places.name: Huashan plank walk
places.why: A vertigo-inducing plank bolted to a cliff face on China's most dangerous sacred mountain.

places.name: Huangshan (Yellow Mountain)
places.why: Granite pillars, pine trees and sea-of-clouds views that inspired centuries of Chinese landscape painting.

places.name: Great Wall of China, Jiankou section
places.why: The wildest, unrestored stretch of the Great Wall, crumbling along a knife-edge ridgeline.

places.name: Mount Kailash Kora
places.why: A three-day pilgrimage circuit around Tibet's most sacred peak, crossing the 5,630 m Dolma La pass; trailhead in Darchen.

places.name: K2 Base Camp Trek
places.why: A remote glacier trek through the Karakoram to the base of the world's second-highest peak; trailhead in Askole.

places.name: Fairy Meadows
places.why: A grassy plateau with a head-on view of Nanga Parbat's Rupal Face, reached by jeep track and short trek.

places.name: Yushan (Jade Mountain)
places.why: Northeast Asia's highest peak outside the Himalaya, a permitted overnight climb to a sunrise summit.

places.name: Zhuilu Old Trail
places.why: A narrow cliffside path carved into a marble gorge wall hundreds of metres above the river; permit required.

places.name: Mount Fuji
places.why: Japan's sacred, near-perfect volcanic cone, climbed overnight for a summit sunrise in the short official season.

places.name: Mount Takao
places.why: One of the world's most-climbed mountains, a forested day trip from central Tokyo with a temple-topped summit.

places.name: Mount Aso crater rim
places.why: A walk along the rim of one of the world's largest active calderas, steam rising from the crater below.

places.name: Yakushima Jomon Sugi Trail
places.why: A mossy, ancient cedar forest trail to Japan's oldest tree, said to be over 2,000 years old.

places.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong
places.why: A short climb up a tuff volcanic cone rising straight from the sea, famous for sunrise views.

places.name: Seoraksan (Ulsanbawi)
places.why: A steep staircase climb to six granite peaks fused into one dramatic summit ridge.

places.name: Mount Kinabalu
places.why: Southeast Asia's highest peak, a permitted two-day climb over granite slabs to a sunrise summit; trailhead at Timpohon Gate.

places.name: Mount Rinjani summit trek
places.why: A three-day volcano trek to a crater lake and a punishing sunrise summit push; trailhead in Sembalun.

places.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek
places.why: A pre-dawn climb up an active volcano for a sunrise view over Bali's crater lake.

places.name: Mount Bromo, Penanjakan viewpoint
places.why: A smoking volcanic cone rising from a sea of ash, viewed at sunrise from Mount Penanjakan.

places.name: Mount Pulag
places.why: The Philippines' third-highest peak, famous for its 'sea of clouds' summit sunrise over grassland ridges.

places.name: Fansipan
places.why: Indochina's highest peak, climbed through cloud forest from Sa Pa's terraced valleys.

places.name: Jebel Shams Balcony Walk
places.why: A vertigo trail along the rim of Oman's 'Grand Canyon', clinging to cliffs a kilometre above the wadi floor.

places.name: Edge of the World (Jebel Fihrayn)
places.why: A dramatic 300 m escarpment along the ancient Tuwaiq Mountains, an abrupt edge over the desert plain.

places.name: Al-Khubtha Trail, Petra
places.why: A steep climb above the Treasury for the classic bird's-eye viewpoint over Petra's rock-cut facade.

places.name: Jordan Trail
places.why: A 675 km cross-country route from the Sea of Galilee to the Red Sea through desert, canyon and village; trailhead at Umm Qais.

places.name: Masada Snake Path
places.why: A pre-dawn switchback climb up Herod's cliff-top fortress above the Dead Sea.

places.name: Kilimanjaro, Machame Route
places.why: Africa's highest peak via its most scenic route, camping through five climate zones; trailhead at Machame Gate.

places.name: Kilimanjaro, Marangu Route
places.why: The original 'Coca-Cola' route to Uhuru Peak, the only one with sleeping huts; trailhead at Marangu Gate.

places.name: Mount Meru
places.why: A steep, wildlife-flanked volcano climb often used to acclimatise before Kilimanjaro; trailhead at Momella Gate.

places.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai
places.why: An active volcano sacred to the Maasai, climbed overnight on loose ash to its carbonatite crater.

places.name: Mount Kenya, Point Lenana
places.why: Africa's second-highest mountain, a multi-day trek past glacial tarns to a non-technical trekking summit; trailhead at Naro Moru Gate.

places.name: Rwenzori Mountains Central Circuit
places.why: The 'Mountains of the Moon', a muddy, hut-to-hut trek through bizarre afro-alpine vegetation; trailhead at Nyakalengija.

places.name: Simien Mountains Trek
places.why: Jagged escarpments and gelada baboon troops on a camping trek through Ethiopia's dramatic highlands; trailhead in Debark.

places.name: Mount Toubkal
places.why: North Africa's highest peak, a two-day trek and scramble from the Berber village of Imlil.

places.name: Todra Gorge
places.why: A narrow limestone canyon with walls up to 300 m high, a favourite Atlas Mountains day walk.

places.name: Fish River Canyon Trail
places.why: One of Africa's largest canyons, a five-day self-supported desert trek along the dry riverbed; trailhead at Hobas.

places.name: Otter Trail
places.why: South Africa's most famous coastal trail, hut to hut along the Garden Route's cliffs and beaches; trailhead at Storms River Mouth.

places.name: Drakensberg Grand Traverse
places.why: An unmarked, high-altitude traverse of the Drakensberg escarpment for experienced mountaineers; trailhead at Sentinel Car Park.

places.name: Table Mountain, Platteklip Gorge
places.why: The steep, direct route up Cape Town's flat-topped icon, one of the New7Wonders of Nature.

places.name: Lion's Head
places.why: A spiralling summit trail with chains and ladders and a 360-degree view over Cape Town and the Atlantic.

places.name: Pic Boby, Andringitra
places.why: Madagascar's second-highest peak, a granite massif trek through unique highland flora.

places.name: Piton de la Fournaise
places.why: One of the world's most active volcanoes, a black lava-field walk to the crater rim.

places.name: Cirque de Cilaos trek (GR R2)
places.why: A hut-to-hut trek through Reunion's dramatic volcanic cirques and needle peaks; trailhead in Cilaos.

places.name: Appalachian Trail
places.why: The original American long-distance trail, 3,500 km through 14 states; southern trailhead at Springer Mountain.

places.name: Pacific Crest Trail
places.why: A desert-to-alpine trail from Mexico to Canada along the crest of the Sierra and Cascades; southern trailhead at Campo.

places.name: John Muir Trail
places.why: A high Sierra classic from Yosemite Valley to Mount Whitney; trailhead at Happy Isles.

places.name: Wonderland Trail
places.why: A full loop around Mount Rainier through old growth, meadow and glacier valley; trailhead at Longmire.

places.name: Colorado Trail
places.why: A high-altitude trail from Denver to Durango across eight mountain ranges; trailhead at Waterton Canyon.

places.name: Long Trail
places.why: America's oldest long-distance trail, the length of Vermont along the Green Mountains; northern trailhead near the Canadian border.

places.name: Enchantments Traverse
places.why: A permit-lottery classic through granite basins and alpine larch beneath the Stuart Range.

places.name: Rae Lakes Loop
places.why: A high Sierra loop past a chain of alpine lakes beneath the Painted Lady; trailhead at Road's End.

places.name: Presidential Traverse
places.why: A committing above-treeline traverse of the White Mountains' Presidential Range, notorious for sudden weather.

places.name: Zion Narrows (top-down)
places.why: A permitted wade down the Virgin River through Zion's slot-canyon narrows; trailhead at Chamberlain's Ranch.

places.name: Grand Canyon Rim-to-Rim
places.why: A classic crossing of the Grand Canyon from the South Kaibab to North Kaibab trailheads.

places.name: Havasu Falls Trek
places.why: A desert descent to turquoise waterfalls on Havasupai tribal land; trailhead at Hualapai Hilltop.

places.name: Chilkoot Trail
places.why: The 1898 Klondike Gold Rush route from tidewater to a high alpine pass; trailhead in Dyea.

places.name: Kalalau Trail
places.why: A permit-only trail along Kauai's sheer Na Pali cliffs to a remote beach valley; trailhead at Ke'e Beach.

places.name: West Coast Trail
places.why: A demanding coastal trail of ladders, cable cars and surge channels along Vancouver Island; trailhead at Pachena Bay.

places.name: Berg Lake Trail
places.why: A trek to a glacier-fed turquoise lake beneath the Canadian Rockies' highest peak; trailhead near Kinney Lake.

places.name: Skoki Loop
places.why: A historic backcountry loop past alpine lakes to Canada's oldest ski lodge; trailhead near Lake Louise.

places.name: Skyline Trail
places.why: A headland loop ending on a boardwalk over the Gulf of St. Lawrence, famous for sunset views.

places.name: Grouse Grind
places.why: A relentless staircase climb up Grouse Mountain, Vancouver's favourite fitness test.

places.name: Stawamus Chief
places.why: A granite monolith with chained scrambles to three summit peaks above Howe Sound.

places.name: Plain of Six Glaciers
places.why: A teahouse trail from Lake Louise into a glacier-ringed valley in the Canadian Rockies.

places.name: Garibaldi Lake
places.why: A vivid turquoise glacial lake beneath volcanic peaks, one of British Columbia's classic day hikes.

places.name: Half Dome
places.why: A permit-only cable ascent up Yosemite's granite icon for one of America's great summit views.

places.name: Angels Landing
places.why: A chain-assisted scramble along a knife-edge sandstone fin above Zion Canyon; permit required.

places.name: Precipice Trail
places.why: An iron rung and ladder scramble up a granite cliff face above Frenchman Bay.

places.name: Longs Peak, Keyhole Route
places.why: Colorado's northernmost fourteener, a long exposed scramble past the famous Keyhole formation.

places.name: Mount Whitney
places.why: The highest summit in the contiguous United States, a long permitted day climb from the Sierra Nevada.

places.name: Angel's Rest
places.why: A basalt outcrop viewpoint high above the Columbia River Gorge's waterfalls.

places.name: Diamond Head
places.why: A short climb through a WWII bunker tunnel to the rim of an extinct volcanic crater above Waikiki.

places.name: Pikes Peak, Barr Trail
places.why: The peak that inspired 'America the Beautiful', climbed via a long, well-graded switchback trail.

places.name: Mount Katahdin, Knife Edge
places.why: The Appalachian Trail's dramatic northern terminus, crossed via an exposed granite arete.

places.name: Old Rag Mountain
places.why: A boulder-scrambling ridge climb through granite chutes to a 360-degree Blue Ridge summit.

places.name: Camelback Mountain
places.why: A steep desert scramble with hand cables to the highest point in central Phoenix.

places.name: Mount Si
places.why: A steep, popular Cascades foothill climb to a rocky summit above the Snoqualmie Valley.

places.name: Cascade Pass
places.why: A switchbacking climb to a high alpine pass ringed by glaciers, one of the North Cascades' finest views.

places.name: Highline Trail
places.why: A cliff-edge trail below the Garden Wall with near-constant views over the Continental Divide.

places.name: Grinnell Glacier Trail
places.why: A trail past a chain of alpine lakes to a viewpoint over one of the park's last remaining glaciers.

places.name: The Wave, Coyote Buttes
places.why: A permit-lottery sandstone formation of swirling, wave-like erosion patterns on the Utah-Arizona line.

places.name: Delicate Arch Trail
places.why: A slickrock climb to Utah's most iconic freestanding sandstone arch, best at sunset.

places.name: Franconia Ridge Loop
places.why: An above-treeline ridge walk over Little Haystack, Lincoln and Lafayette, one of the East's best alpine hikes.

places.name: Mount Marcy
places.why: New York's highest summit, a long forested climb in the High Peaks Wilderness.

places.name: Maroon Bells, Crater Lake
places.why: One of the most photographed views in America, twin fourteeners reflected in an alpine lake.

places.name: Nevado de Toluca
places.why: A dormant volcano with two crater lakes inside its caldera, a high-altitude day climb near Mexico City.

places.name: Pico de Orizaba
places.why: North America's third-highest peak and highest volcano, a glaciated technical climb from mountain huts.

places.name: Copper Canyon (Urique) Trek
places.why: A descent into a canyon system larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon, through Raramuri territory; trailhead at Divisadero.

places.name: Acatenango Volcano
places.why: An overnight camp on a volcano's flank for a front-row view of neighbouring Fuego erupting through the night.

places.name: Pacaya Volcano
places.why: An active volcano day climb over cooled lava fields, close enough to roast marshmallows on residual heat.

places.name: Cerro Chirripo
places.region: San Gerardo de Rivas, Costa Rica
places.why: Costa Rica's highest peak, a permitted two-day climb through cloud forest to a paramo summit.

places.name: Arenal 1968 Trail
places.why: A walk over hardened lava flows from Arenal Volcano's last major eruption, with views of the cone.

places.name: Volcan Baru
places.why: Panama's highest point and only volcano, climbed overnight for a rare view of both oceans at once.

places.name: Waitukubuli National Trail
places.why: The Eastern Caribbean's first long-distance trail, through rainforest and along volcanic coast; trailhead at Scotts Head.

places.name: Gros Piton
places.why: A steep, guide-required climb up Saint Lucia's iconic volcanic plug for a Caribbean panorama.

places.name: Blue Mountain Peak
places.why: Jamaica's highest peak, usually climbed overnight through coffee farms for a Caribbean sunrise.

places.name: Pico Duarte
places.why: The Caribbean's highest summit, a multi-day pine forest trek with mules carrying camp gear.

places.name: El Yunque Peak
places.region: El Yunque National Forest, Puerto Rico
places.why: A climb through the only tropical rainforest in the US National Forest System to a misty summit.

places.name: Inca Trail
places.why: The classic permitted route to Machu Picchu over three Andean passes; trailhead at Km 82.

places.name: Salkantay Trek
places.why: An unpermitted alternative to the Inca Trail beneath a sacred glaciated peak; trailhead in Mollepata.

places.name: Choquequirao Trek
places.why: A steep canyon trek to a remote, rarely visited sister city of Machu Picchu; trailhead in Cachora.

places.name: Huayhuash Circuit
places.why: A high circuit past turquoise lakes and some of the Andes' most dramatic ice peaks; trailhead in Llamac.

places.name: Ausangate Trek
places.why: A circuit of a sacred glaciated peak past the Rainbow Mountain and alpine lakes; trailhead in Tinki.

places.name: Colca Canyon Trek
places.why: A descent into one of the world's deepest canyons to an oasis, home to condors overhead; trailhead in Cabanaconde.

places.name: Torres del Paine W Trek
places.why: Patagonia's signature trek past granite towers, glaciers and turquoise lakes; trailhead at the Laguna Amarga entrance.

places.name: Dientes de Navarino Circuit
places.why: The world's southernmost trek, an unmarked circuit of jagged peaks at the tip of South America; trailhead in Puerto Williams.

places.name: Cerro Castillo Trek
places.why: A dramatic crossing beneath a castle-like granite massif on Chile's Carretera Austral; trailhead in Villa Cerro Castillo.

places.name: Volcan Villarrica
places.why: A crampons-and-ice-axe climb up one of Chile's most active volcanoes to a smoking crater rim.

places.name: Fitz Roy, Laguna de los Tres
places.why: A steep final climb to an alpine lake beneath Mount Fitz Roy's granite spires; trailhead in El Chalten.

places.name: Quilotoa Loop
places.why: A trek between indigenous highland villages to a turquoise crater lake; trailhead at Quilotoa.

places.name: Cotopaxi
places.why: One of the world's highest active volcanoes, a glaciated overnight climb from a mountain refuge.

places.name: Mount Roraima Trek
places.why: A trek to the flat-topped tepui that inspired 'The Lost World', with its own alien ecosystem on top; trailhead in Paraitepui.

places.name: Lost City Trek (Ciudad Perdida)
places.why: A jungle trek to a pre-Columbian city older than Machu Picchu, crossing rivers by foot; trailhead at Machete Pelao.

places.name: Pico da Bandeira
places.why: One of Brazil's highest peaks, a short climb through granite boulder fields for a sunrise above the clouds.

places.name: Pedra da Gavea
places.why: A jungle scramble with fixed ropes to the world's largest coastal monolith, overlooking Rio's beaches.

places.name: Pao de Acucar hiking trail
places.why: A rock-climbing approach trail up Sugarloaf Mountain for views over Guanabara Bay.

places.name: Vale do Pati Trek
places.why: A multi-day trek through Brazil's Chapada Diamantina past waterfalls, mesas and highland valleys; trailhead at Vale do Capao.

places.name: Overland Track
places.why: Tasmania's premier alpine trek past Cradle Mountain and ancient rainforest; trailhead at Ronny Creek.

places.name: Cradle Mountain Summit
places.why: A boulder-scramble climb above Dove Lake to Tasmania's most recognisable summit.

places.name: Wineglass Bay Lookout
places.why: A short climb to the classic viewpoint over one of the world's most perfect curved white-sand bays.

places.name: Great Ocean Walk
places.why: A coastal trek past the Twelve Apostles' limestone stacks along Victoria's shipwreck coast; trailhead in Apollo Bay.

places.name: Cape to Cape Track
places.why: A wildflower-lined coastal trek between two lighthouses on the Margaret River coast; trailhead at Cape Naturaliste.

places.name: Bibbulmun Track
places.why: A long-distance trail through jarrah forest and karri giants to the south coast; trailhead in Kalamunda.

places.name: Larapinta Trail
places.why: A remote desert ridge-walk along the West MacDonnell Ranges; trailhead at Simpsons Gap near Alice Springs.

places.name: Mount Kosciuszko
places.why: Australia's highest peak, a gentle boardwalk climb through alpine wildflower country.

places.name: The Pinnacle, Grampians
places.why: A sandstone lookout wedged between cliffs, the signature view of the Grampians ranges.

places.name: Figure Eight Pools coastal walk
places.region: Royal National Park, New South Wales
places.why: A tide-dependent coastal scramble to natural rock pools carved into a sandstone shelf.

places.name: Uluru Base Walk
places.why: A circuit around the base of Australia's most sacred monolith, past waterholes and rock art.

places.name: Tongariro Alpine Crossing
places.why: New Zealand's most popular day hike, over active volcanic craters and the emerald-green Ngauruhoe cone.

places.name: Milford Track
places.why: New Zealand's 'finest walk', through glacier-carved valleys to Milford Sound; trailhead at Glade Wharf.

places.name: Routeburn Track
places.why: A hut-to-hut Great Walk over an alpine pass between Fiordland and Mount Aspiring; trailhead at Routeburn Shelter.

places.name: Kepler Track
places.why: A loop over exposed alpine tussock ridgelines above Lake Te Anau; trailhead at the Kepler Control Gates.

places.name: Abel Tasman Coast Track
places.why: A golden-beach coastal Great Walk through New Zealand's smallest national park; trailhead in Marahau.

places.name: Heaphy Track
places.why: A varied Great Walk from beech forest over open tops to nikau-palm-lined west coast beaches; trailhead at Brown Hut.

places.name: Rakiura Track
places.why: A muddy, birdsong-filled loop through native forest on New Zealand's southernmost inhabited island; trailhead in Oban.

places.name: Roys Peak
places.why: A switchbacking climb to a viewpoint over Lake Wanaka and the Southern Alps, one of New Zealand's most Instagrammed.

places.name: Hooker Valley Track
places.why: A swing-bridge trail to a glacial lake with icebergs beneath New Zealand's highest peak.

places.name: Kokoda Track
places.why: A gruelling WWII-history jungle trek across the Owen Stanley Range; trailhead at Owers' Corner.

places.name: Lavena Coastal Walk
places.why: A palm-lined coastal walk on Fiji's 'Garden Island', ending at a waterfall swimming hole.
